documents.title: Catheter out
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Good news, catheter came out yesterday. They did the dye x-ray first and said the bladder healed, no leak. Peeing on my own fine. Urology said they'd send you a note.

documents.title: RE: Catheter out
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: That's great news. Call us if you get burning, fever, trouble emptying, or blood in the urine. I'll note it in your chart and look out for their note.

documents.title: Records follow-up: trauma center
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Called trauma center HIM re: 12/26 request for the 12/19-12/23 admission. Told it is in the queue. Re-faxed the request and signed release. Also asked urology office for the 1/6 visit note - they will send when signed.

documents.title: Work note
documents.author: patient
documents.body: My manager needs a note that I can go back to driving the territory starting Feb 2. Surgeon cleared me already. Can you write one?

documents.title: Return to work letter
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
To whom it may concern,

Brandon Slattery is under my care. He may return to his usual duties, including driving, as of February 2, 2026, without restrictions.

Please contact our office with questions.

Primary Care Physician

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Routine f/u, BP and anxiety; first visit since the bladder repair.

ED record from 12/19 came in January (CT: intraperitoneal rupture at the dome, BUN 36 / Cr 1.8 on arrival). Still no discharge summary or op note, and nothing from urology. Per him the 1/6 cystogram showed no leak and the catheter came out.

GU: voiding normally, good stream, no burning or blood, no leaking, empties fully. Incision healed.
Back at work since Feb 2. Driving fine, he says, belt on.
HTN: no symptoms. On lisinopril 10.
GAD: GAD-7 6, PHQ-9 3. Doing better than he expected after the winter.
Smoking: same, 10/day. Not ready.

Exam: well. Lungs clear. Heart RRR. Abdomen soft, healed lower midline scar, nontender. No edema.

A/P:
1. Intraperitoneal bladder rupture s/p repair - healed per urology, asymptomatic. Resolved.
2. HTN - continue lisinopril 10. BMP.
3. Blunt thoracic aortic injury s/p TEVAR - 1-yr CTA with vascular in June.
4. GAD - stable, sertraline 50.
5. Tobacco - counseled.
BP/smoking check in May, physical in September.

documents.title: BMP
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Kidney function and potassium normal. See you in May.

documents.title: Refill: lisinopril, sertraline
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pharmacy e-requests, lisinopril 10 mg #90 and sertraline 50 mg #90. Seen 3/17, BMP normal. Approved x1 refill each.

documents.title: Appointment cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt called to cancel tomorrow 2:40 - overnight work trip to the eastern part of his territory. Doesn't want to reschedule before the physical; will keep the September visit. Will message if anything comes up.

documents.title: Aorta scan
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Had my 1 year CT for the aorta stent on Thursday 6/18. The vascular surgeon told me it looks stable. FYI.

documents.title: RE: Aorta scan
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Thanks for letting me know - glad it looks good. We don't have the report yet, so our front desk will request it from the vascular office.

documents.title: Records request: vascular surgery
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Faxed request to vascular surgery clinic for the 6/18/26 CT angiogram report and visit note. Release on file.

documents.title: Records request follow-up
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Nothing received from vascular surgery for the 6/18 CTA. Called the clinic, spoke with their front desk, request located, re-faxed. They said it should go out this week. Flagged for PCP to watch for it.

documents.title: Lisinopril and physical
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Can you send a lisinopril refill, pharmacy says I'm out of refills. Also still on for the physical 9/22 at 8:30?

documents.title: RE: Lisinopril and physical
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Lisinopril 10 mg sent, 90 days with 1 refill. Yes, you're set for 9/22 at 8:30. Come fasting if you can - the doctor may order labs.
